experiences.description: Comprehensive foundational year in IT, covering the core principles of software development, networking, operating systems, databases, security and project management. Built various practical applications using Java, Python and web technologies and gained experience with Spring Boot, MySQL, Firebase and IoT. Learned to work with Agile methods, version control (Git) and gained exposure to full-stack development.

Worked on two major internal projects: MediStock, a full-stack material reservation tool developed with React and Flask and SalesChamp, a B2B-focused CRM enhancement. Focused on frontend development, state management, database design and implementing secure user interactions. Collaborated with designers, backend engineers and business stakeholders in an agile, fast-paced environment. I also worked closely with [@Neo Stutz](https://neo.sunrise-avengers.ch/) and participated in many 'Schnupper Tage' and other outreach events with children interested in our profession. I also had a great time working and learning alongside my fellow apprentices [@Nik Brönnimann](https://nik.sunrise-avengers.ch/), [@Bareth Balakanthan](https://bareth.sunrise-avengers.ch/) and [@Simon Schiller](https://simon.sunrise-avengers.ch/). Together we built, learned, and laughed — and even made our own site at [@Digital Avengers Lab](https://sunrise-avengers.ch).

experiences.position: DAL (Digital Avengers Lab) | Stage as Platform Engineer
experiences.description: During this time, I built a standalone Raspberry Pi router and access point—completely air-gapped—serving a local web portal via custom domains and reverse-proxy rules. I also wrote Bash scripts to continuously ping multiple PCs, funneling those performance metrics into InfluxDB and crafting real-time Grafana dashboards that show per-machine uptime, latency, and bandwidth. If any machine went offline, automated alerting would fire off an email to the administrator. On the network side, I designed and implemented a dual-zone architecture behind a firewall to keep development and operations traffic isolated and secure.
